packages.notes: Beta: Satisfaction is now off WebKit entirely (first slice) -- wos-sat-run renders .satUI as real native GTK widgets, no HTML/JS anywhere. New: satshell, a real parallel desktop shell (desktop/bar/dock) written in Satisfaction and rendered natively -- run 'wos-satisfaction-session' from a Terminal to try it (it'll overlap the real bar/dock for now; not yet a selectable login session, that needs a new ISO).
